note: Extra series for batch_screen plugins, one CSV per series. Sources: the Yahoo chart API (period1=0, daily, `events=div,split`: columns `date,close,adjclose`) and FRED CSV (columns `date,value`). Refresh with `python -m research.batch_screen.extra --fetch-all`, add a series with --fetch/--fetch-fred, check every hash and range with --verify. A key is a series name or a {"windows": {window: series}} map; `data.extra(key)` returns the series aligned to the panel's own sessions (the drawn source session inside a bootstrap chunk), NaN where the series has no value on that date. Nothing is forward-filled unless the plugin asks for `ffill=True`.
